decisions.reason: The garage door operator line has its own web page and builds directly on the firm's core door expertise, so the firm can read its market feedback well and keep refining it.

A solid wood door draws on materials knowledge outside the firm's steel core and is a niche item that is only mentioned on the website, but it still fits the one-source garage range and its early results can be judged through the dealer network.
The remote-control operator overlaps with the Product A line and may be folded into it, but it rests on knowledge the firm already holds and complements its garage doors.
Glazed industrial sectional doors are a close extension of the firm's industrial door competence, though overlap with the similar Products E and F creates some risk of the range being consolidated.
The insulated glazed version uses the firm's thermal-solution expertise and meets demand driven by energy regulation, so the firm can develop it further with confidence.
This glazed sectional door has a dedicated page, which signals it is a priority, and it sits squarely within the firm's existing manufacturing and materials knowledge.
